dispute_ticket.description: I reached Jurong East MRT on time and waited. I called and messaged the passenger but got nothing back, so I cancelled as no-show. The app says the no-show fee is on hold and I have not been paid. Please release it to my wallet.

app_events.details: Rider R-7102 booked RYDE-DA-002 from Jurong East MRT (Exit A) to Orchard Road (ION). Pickup 19:00.
Driver arrived at pickup, GPS within 15 m of pickup point.
Driver sent chat message to rider.
Driver initiated in-app call; rang 30s, no answer.
Rider phone location 2.6 km from pickup, stationary.
Driver cancelled, reason rider_no_show, 9 min after arrival.
S$8.00 no-show fee charged to rider; credit to driver held pending review.

chat_logs.content: Hi, I am at Exit A of Jurong East MRT, white Honda Vezel. Where are you?
Outgoing in-app call to rider - not answered (rang 30s).
Waiting at Exit A. Please reply or I will have to cancel.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee S$8.00 applied.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from the driver_arrived event, before the rider counts as a no-show and the no-show fee may be charged.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider for a no-show, once the driver has waited at the pickup point for the full no-show threshold. It does not cover a cancellation the driver makes before the threshold is reached.

driver_must_contact_rider.text: Before cancelling for no-show the driver must have tried to reach the rider by in-app call or chat message during the wait. A call or message logged in the trip record counts as contact.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: driver_arrived at 19:02 with GPS at the pickup; cancelled 19:11 = 9 min wait, over the 8 min threshold. Driver messaged (19:03, 19:08) and called (19:04), so the contact condition is met; rider phone was 2.6 km away. The S$8.00 no-show fee held by the platform is due to the driver.
